description: With Bissantz Tables, the widely recognized Bissantz rules and principles for the form and content of KPI management can also be applied in Power BI— fully automated! The common variance reports that every company needs are generated in a matter of seconds. Instead of charts, we rely on what we call “graphical tables”: pivot tables whose numerical values are supplemented by graphical elements or even become images themselves. Our signaling concept, using the two colors red and blue, ensures quick orientation. With the patented Bissantz’Numbers, the font size is chosen proportionally to the value—the larger the value, the larger the number. This is as simple as it is effective and conveys directly what the numbers are saying. Sparklines incorporate temporal trends in the form of miniaturized time series representations. This provides context for key metrics, allowing changes to be compared as patterns. Our visual does all this and much more—with just a few mouse clicks.
